ac:rich-text-body.p: This space is a fixture for the Initiative Confluence importer. Every page exists to exercise something specific; the map below says what. Please don't tidy it up.

td.p: Every inline mark, headings, table with rowspan/colspan and cell colour, nested lists, code, layouts, all panel types, expand, blockquote, status, date, mention, emoji, internal and anchor links, labels, footer comments with replies, an inline comment, a reaction
Deep nesting (four levels), fixed-width table, three versions including a minor edit
Code blocks in several languages, no language, wrapped, hidden line numbers, code inside a table cell, HTML entities in code
Task lists (checked, unchecked, nested), block task, decisions
Page restrictions (set by hand; see the page)
Jira macro, Jira smart links and block card, dates and statuses in a table, a resolved inline comment
Meeting Notes and its two children
Content-by-label macro, shared labels across pages, date-titled pages
Folders, a nested folder, special characters and Unicode in titles, an empty page, a near-255-character title, a macro gallery, attachments and images, a whiteboard
Blog: Welcome to the import test space
Blog posts, which sit outside the page tree
